scope: Selected Aurora visual refinement: Light and Dark concept boards plus forward design/input requirements. No native runtime implementation in this package.
owner_instruction_exact: Aurora. But lets make a dark them for it too. We dont a on-screen joystick. the user can touch anywhere

requirements.requirement: Aurora is the owner-selected visual family; retain its sparse floating HUD and hierarchy.
Produce matching Light and Dark concept boards, each with landscape and portrait compositions.
Remove every visible fixed/floating joystick, directional pad, movement-origin dot, thumb ring or drag trail from all four views.
Keep the former joystick area as unobstructed game world; retain modest Camp and primary Build controls.
Dark theme changes UI surfaces/text; preserve the same daylight world, character, buildings, camera, resources and camp lighting.
Keep readable status/objective/resource counts and clearly labeled minimap expansion in both themes/orientations.
No visible overlapping or clipped controls; retain safe-looking margins and open central gameplay.
Preserve stylized blue-orange winter camp, centered furnace and two open gate passages.
Record touch-anywhere as owner direction; explicitly identify proposed drag/release/ownership details as implementation interpretation.
Preserve all old concepts and generated revisions; distinguish owner family selection from approval of new art or runtime.

proposed_input_interpretation.movement: Touch and drag anywhere in the gameplay viewport not owned by UI, including over world objects, establishes an invisible origin; drag direction controls movement. Release stops movement. No visible joystick appears. No empty-ground restriction or fixed thumb zone.
proposed_input_interpretation.tap_behavior: A tap without meaningful drag should not cause unintended walking; dead-zone and response tuning remain unfixed.
proposed_input_interpretation.exclusions: Touches beginning on buttons, status/menu interactions, minimap, expanded map or modal UI are owned by that UI and do not initiate movement.
proposed_input_interpretation.multitouch: One stable movement pointer may coexist with a separate eligible nonmodal UI pointer; pointers do not change ownership when crossing a control boundary.
proposed_input_interpretation.cancellation: Release, OS touch cancellation, focus loss, rotation, fold/resize or blocking modal opening clears movement immediately. Fresh touch required to resume.
proposed_input_interpretation.automatic_actions: Existing automatic/contextual gathering and attacking retained; no new tap-to-destination pathfinding implied.
proposed_input_interpretation.first_use_hint: Optional dismissible first-use cue: Drag anywhere to move. No permanent movement overlay.

supersession: This owner selection and no-visible-joystick direction supersede the earlier unselected-option state and visible-joystick concept guidance for new UI work. Historical files remain unchanged.

milestones.name: Create matching Light and Dark without joystick
